title: EXX @PBE bands are completely garbage (implausible gap, jagged branches, NaNs)
symptom: The EXX band structure is unreasonable: an implausible gap, jagged branches, NaN values, or high raw bands collapsing into the near-gap manifold.
root_cause: A basis/PP mismatch, a shallow pseudopotential, a mismatched orbital family, an incomplete state space (nbands < nbasis), or an indefinite Coulomb matrix upstream of the EXX construction.
minimal_fix: Run the EXX chain retest in order: (1) verify the pseudopotential and matched numerical-orbital family, (2) verify the auxiliary basis (ABFS) generation, (3) check nbands == nbasis, (4) check the Coulomb PSD/Hermitian gate. Fix the first failing link; do not tune the EXX output directly.
validation: A clean PseudoDojo stringent / vetted Dojo-NC-SR PP with a matched orbital set gives continuous physical EXX bands and a plausible gap. Preserve the negative diagnostic rather than masking it.
avoid: Masking the symptom (clipping, changing the band window, or substituting a different functional) before identifying the causal link.
source: ghj-stringent-dojo-exx-diagnostic skill; abacus-pp-pbe-head-screening; ~/.codex sessions on abnormal EXX bands.
